_comment: News sources we keep. Owned by the team: add or remove outlets here, no code change needed. News from any other outlet is not shown in the report, not given to the writers and not read by the research desk. Company documents (results releases, filings, announcements, call summaries) and broker reports are not news and are never filtered by this list. A source is kept when its publisher name is in 'names', or, for a direct link, when the website is in 'domains'. Links through an aggregator (finnhub, Yahoo Finance, EastMoney, MSN, Bing) are judged by the publisher's name only, because the aggregator also carries low-quality sites. Names are compared ignoring case, spaces, punctuation, a leading 'The' and a trailing '.com'. Set NEWS_ALLOWLIST=0 to switch the list off.
